notes.title: Gamescom Update
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115665/425f45dd0daebd670363123b4ee0cf9cd3f3ed15.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s been a while since the last update due to the mentioned circumstances, but today we have a new build for you with some major changes and recent news. [/p][p]While we are working on sandbox mode and a new iteration of Ro.oTO a new progression system has been added and we changed the way of earning Data. Due to the new balancing of difficulty and progression we needed to reset all Hacker \[R]anking points. Bootcamp missions and settings stay as they are. We fixed many bugs and there are some other cool things to see.[/p][p]You highly requested a Wiki for Net.Attack() and we set up a page with the first pieces of information that can be used, filled and modified by you! Therefore we set up a new Discord channel if you have questions, feedback or any other wiki related issues. [url="https://netattack.wiki.gg/"]https://netattack.wiki.gg/[/url][/p][p]Net.Attack() can be played at the exhibition booth of ByteRockers' Games at Gamescom in Cologne. There will be some merch to grab and ROS!E is playable in the Daily Challenge again from August 20th to 24th not only at Gamecom, but also for everyone at home.   [/p][p][/p][p]We know you have been waiting for an update, and we are happy to finally upload a new build. Hopefully you’ll enjoy the changes! [/p][p]Have a nice Gamescom week and happy hacking![/p][p][/p][h1]Changes:[/h1][p][/p][h3]General:[/h3][list][*][p]Data is earned primarily through leveling up rather than by extracting chips[/p][list][*][p]Nodes and upgrades that worked with chip extraction have been adjusted[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial rework along the new mechanic[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Mode “30Minute.Hack” available in difficulty selection → Play the Daily Challenge with your chosen character, region, and your progression[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Daily Challenge:[/p][list][*][p]Time is now limited to 30 minutes[/p][/*][*][p]The damage caused determines your ranking if you survive the 30 minutes[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New destroyable object (Capacitor) in level that provides random rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies have more variation in speed and knockback resistance[/p][/*][*][p]Save Game can be reset in the options (accessibility tab)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Ingame Upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]There are new achievements to unlock[/p][/*][/list][h3]Metagame Progression:[/h3][list][*][p]New currency “Files (Ш)” can be earned via chip extraction[/p][/*][*][p]New menu “Dark Market” where “Files” can be exchanged[/p][/*][*][p]Balancing and difficulty has been adjusted[/p][/*][*][p]HackerRanking points had to be reset[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugfixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Leveling every Ingame Upgrade no longer blocks the game[/p][/*][*][p]Select Nodes no longer kills the player under certain conditions[/p][/*][*][p]After a Bootcamp mission the code can be reviewed[/p][/*][*][p]Undo function caused false port connections[/p][/*][*][p]Some Root Nodes didn’t execute correctly[/p][/*][*][p]A bunch of text issues[/p][/*][*][p]Several other minor bugs[/p][/*][/list][h3]Known Issues:[/h3][list][*][p]Daily Challenge ranking display can differ in Run Summary and Daily Challenge screen.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix Update 0.1.276
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone , it’s Hotfix time! [/p][p]Net.Attack() has been in Early Access for over a week now and we have really enjoyed watching you play the game while we analyzed the channels, videos, and reviews.[/p][p] We’ve received so much helpful feedback from you that we wanted to spend some time fixing some of the annoying or unbalanced issues and bugs before diving into further content and feature development. [/p][p]Thanks for taking your time to share your ideas![/p][p]Since we love playing ROS!E in Daily Challenge mode, she will be playable again on July 1st and 5th to celebrate the first Early Access Update! Have a nice week and happy hacking![/p][p][img src="https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1311625672761802793/1389561911485403257/Discordpost_04.png?ex=686511e0&is=6863c060&hm=531d4bc35297d685bb31777a0f7d02986589dddfad7a5fe79ab9968c0ef6e731&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=550&height=106"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Changelog:[/b] As some of you may be interested, we decided to deliver a more detailed changelog for the things that are worth knowing. Some of them were requested directly by you : [/p][p][/p][p][b]General:[/b][/p][p]Buff stacks are not deleted after leaving coding environment,[/p][list][*][p] Projectiles are only deleted if the code has been changed,[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option for setting the VFX transparency,[/p][/*][*][p]“Pause” menu doesn’t open when tabbing out in coding environment,[/p][/*][*][p]Level exit now also opens when firewall is activated,[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Reroll pickup instead of gaining Rerolls per layer,[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy waves balancing improvements,[/p][/*][*][p]Mines were buffed,[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Player/Characters:[/b][/p][list][*][p] More opportunities for healing,[/p][/*][*][p] Improved coin collection for every character,[/p][/*][*][p]Basic player speed increased,[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies will be pushed back after hitting the player,[/p][/*][*][p]Hop²a: root nodes modified,[/p][/*][*][p]Hop²a: “Combine” node was removed,[/p][/*][*][p]Hop²a: Infection tick time was buffed,[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Nodes:[/b][/p][list][*][p] “For” nodes have mostly “Once”-Inports,[/p][/*][*][p]“Sequence” nodes have higher rarity,[/p][/*][*][p]“For(NodeDepth)” node was removed,[/p][/*][*][p]“Push” node has greater effect on smaller enemies,[/p][/*][*][p]The root node in Bootcamp missions now triggers only once,[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Upgrades:[/b][/p][list][*][p] Selection visibility improved,[/p][/*][*][p]Overall upgrade experience points balancing,[/p][/*][*][p]There are upgrades with maximum 3 or 5 available points now,[/p][/*][*][p]“Time Converter”: effect was doubled,[/p][/*][*][p]“Skill Farmer”: effect was buffed,[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Recursion should work properly and is powerful again!,[/p][/*][*][p]“Adaptable Investor” notes.title: Net.Attack() Challenge Mode Demo Update
notes.notes:
We’ve just released an update for Net.Attack() in which we added the new “Challenge Mode”. This will replace the Highscore Heist and is available from the main menu.

Your goal is still to survive as long as you can, but everyone gets the same character, level and the exact same nodes in the shop! These restrictions and your highscores are reset daily, so that you have 24 hours to prove your skills!

Changes:

[list]
[*] New Challenge Mode
[*] Balancing changes for Zu5el, difficulties, enemies
[*] Pings are making a lot more damage now
[*] Overclock no longer makes extra damage to the player
[*] The first two difficulty levels are now significantly easier
[*] Instead of node families be unlocked within a run, every node related to the chosen character can appear from the beginning now
[*] Bugfixes
[/list]

We are currently working on making Hop²a available to you again, so stay tuned and happy hacking!

notes.title: Net.Attack() Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey there,

thank you all for sticking with us as we’ve been working hard to further develop the game over the past few weeks, and welcome to all new Net.Attackers!

There has been so much valuable feedback and ideas showing your needs and wishes for the final game and we want to let you know how grateful we are.

Therefore we're excited to share the brand new version with you now and can’t wait to read your thoughts on your experience!

Changes:
[list]
[*] a bunch of new nodes
[*] balancing updates everywhere
[*] new enemies and wave behaviour
[*] Visible tag system for nodes
[*] Options for different screen resolutions
[*] general option functionality
[*] Big HUD mode
[*] improved node screen usability
[*] reworked character selection
[*] many new VFX and graphical improvements
[*] support for different coding conventions (PascalCase, kebab-case, camelCase, snake_case)
[/list]

Temporary Changes:
[list]
[*] The Highscore Heist mode is currently deactivated and will soon be replaced by a new Highscore system.
[*] Some Nodes are not available at the moment.
[*] Due to ongoing reworks only one character can be played.
[/list]

As some of you may have noticed, we did not participate in Steam Next Fest in February. This is due to some timetable changes that have to be made.

As we are back on track, we plan to provide you with regularly updated versions while we add more content to the game starting with this release.

Happy Hacking everyone and thanks for sharing your epic Net.Attack() moments - seeing this is the best thing for us!

[i]*Psst*[/i] You can also find a cheat code for the second level of the demo on our [url=https://discord.gg/BeDfDmKACR]Discord[/url] ;)
